column1:
3456-00-102-0306
National Food
Security Mission
(Inter-State Handling
of Food and Fair
Price Shop Dealers
Margin Under
NFSA) (Centrally
Sponsored Scheme)
column7:
Surrender of ₹12,514.43
lakh was attributed to
additional amounts as per
division of central share
by the Government of
India into three series i.e.
General, Scheduled Caste
and Scheduled Tribe series
under NFSA of Centrally
Sponsored Scheme in the
financial year 2023-24.
Final excess of ₹13,103.80
lakh is overstated by
₹13,103.82 lakh due to
clearance of OB suspense
related to previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹0.02 lakh.
Reasons for actual saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
